0022600125.text: The Houston Rockets (3-0, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) host the Atlanta Hawks (2-1, 1st in the Southeast and 3rd in the East) in the Rockets' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Atlanta coming in on a one-game losing streak. Houston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 121-114 win in Atlanta on 2026-10-24, and the Rockets also won both meetings in the 2025-26 season. Steven Adams is out with a calf strain, Marcus Smart is day-to-day with a forearm strain and is a game-time decision, and Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), both listed as out.
